title: A commit-time guard refuses a commit whose staged diff holds conflict markers
why: Incident, lane merge-waits-required-only, 2026-11-07 02:36 CST, relayed by the coordinator 02:38 CST: a conflict-fix script failed, and the next chained command still committed the conflict markers (locally only). A fix commit removed them before any push.
note: The guard runs `git diff --cached --check` at commit time and refuses when it finds conflict markers. Done check: a red test on a staged marker, and green on a clean commit. The guard's verdict changes, so this is a build lane (test-author, builder, reviewer). No owner question.
